## Activity

During June 2021, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 39 captures. Activity was delivered through the site’s planned session lists, with routine leave being the only noted variation. The available activity indicates that imaging sessions proceeded as expected during the month. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for this reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the 39 captures, 1 was ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.6 per cent. The ungradable result should be considered when reviewing the overall completeness of the month’s activity and the subsequent grading results. All remaining captures were available for grading.

## Grading

There were 4 referable results during June 2021. The median grading wait was 1 day. Taken together, the activity and grading information provides a concise view of service delivery at Oakridge Primary Care for the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave.
